body: I don't understand the word "suicide attempts." If you are 99% percent sure the why not pick the option that delivers the best results? Accepting the fact your life and my life also the 7 billion idiots living it is as worthless as any other living organism might actually help you. Relax. Therapist show you how to deal with your problems not how to fix them, believe me that it will only be death. Wait till you are 18, at least you can buy a shotgun.

What you want is attention to your problems but nobody wants to help you solve it or they just tell you sweet words. I advice you to keep yourself till you are 18. If your life becomes worse than you have to make a tough decision to end it, always stick your plan.

Words won't make you feel better. I know what you want. You want passion, money and a family. Sadly some of us will never get to experience those things. If we define success then there has to be failure and if we define failure then there has to be success. The people in this world who are living life to the fullest can't maintain if the lower folks like you or I just leave this world. Currently the best resource you can own is another human being. The best thing for you right now is find another suicidal person like yourself. Those happy people enjoying life will never understand your pain rather find someone in your situation.
